reason: Verified in source and in pixels. b.css:387 .b-edit declares `background: var(--back)` on line 390 and `background: var(--fore-06)` on line 396 in the same rule; the later shorthand wins, so the panel's computed backgroundColor is rgba(255,255,255,0.06) in approach and record and rgba(17,17,17,0.06) in paper, with backgroundImage `none`. The comment two lines above promises 'an opaque ground so nothing reads through', so it is an unambiguous plumbing slip. Because the measure is absolutely positioned, the rows behind the panel do not move out of the way, and a screenshot of .b-edit at 1440 shows 'Final dress fitting', 'SAT 22 AUG', 'Choose the evening music' and 'Final guest numbers' printed straight through the panel and colliding with the editor's own type ('-7 / -1' sit inside the word 'fitting'; 'WHAT GUESTS SEE' is buried under a 24px title). Range-rect measurement finds text-box intersections >4px in both axes at every width tested: 15 pairs at 390, 8 at 768, 7 at 1280, 7 at 1440 — the seat's '13 pairs at 1440' and its individual overlap figures (347px, 486px) are inflated, but the defect and its universality are exactly as claimed, and this is in owner-editing, the state the owner lives in. Applying the proposed fix live produces a clean, fully opaque plate in all three rooms with no other regression. Not covered by either gate: audit.mjs checks palette, weights and contrast against a composited backdrop, and interaction-check.mjs asserts behaviour; neither looks for text-box collisions.
sharpenedFix: In b.css .b-edit, delete the second `background: var(--fore-06);` (line 396) and change the first declaration to `background-color: var(--back); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--fore-06), var(--fore-06));`. Token-based, so it is correct in all three rooms without a per-room override; no new hue, weight or family, so the audit gate is unaffected. Keep `z-index: 2` on both .b-edit and .b-item[data-editing="true"]. .b-input already paints `var(--back)`, so the panel plate is the only hole — no other rule needs touching. Correct the finding's own numbers when logging it (7 colliding pairs at 1280/1440, 8 at 768, 15 at 390; the widest single overlap at 1440 is 120px, not 486px). Add the regression assertion to interaction-check.mjs as: in state owner-editing at 390/768/1280/1440, for every Range client rect of a text node inside .b-edit, assert zero intersection >2px in both axes with any text-node rect outside .b-edit; run it for v=approach, paper and record, since all three inherit the same rule.
